method.note: Canonical TS evaluator copied/transpiled into /private/tmp; verified real raw RG8 and RGBA8 bytes; fixture periodic trilinear fixed-domain noise; bilinear reference field in the interior of the reference patch. Vertical columns from 20 km (all cloud support below 14 km), no atmosphere/lighting/camera reconstruction/GPU inference. Centre 25 m midpoint, 12.5 m convergence; zone 50 m. Mips diagnostic CPU box averages only. Coverage occupancy ablation is exploratory, not a proposed final tuning.

candidateFormula: N=clamp((0.85*R+0.15*A-0.40)/0.17,0,1); C=coverage*coverageCurve(h); occupied=C>0?smoothstep(1-C-0.08,1-C+0.08,N):0; rho=densityCurve(h)*supportTaper*clamp(occupied-erosionDepth*erosionMask,0,1). Diagnostic empirical bracket, not final calibrated coverage-percentile semantics. Optional sigma_t x4 only after shape change.
